study_label: Tocilizumab add-on versus switch from methotrexate in active rheumatoid arthritis

objective.value: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy in patients with persistent active disease despite methotrexate therapy.

population.value: Patients with confirmed rheumatoid arthritis meeting 1987 ACR criteria, active disease (baseline DAS28–ESR >4.4 and screening DAS28–ESR ≥4.0), receiving methotrexate for at least 12 weeks at a stable dose of at least 15 mg/week for at least 6 weeks, with radiographic evidence of at least one RA-attributable erosion. Prior biologic use was excluded.

intervention.value: Add-on strategy: tocilizumab 8 mg/kg intravenously every 4 weeks plus continued methotrexate, with methotrexate administered double-blind.

comparator.value: Switch strategy: tocilizumab 8 mg/kg intravenously every 4 weeks plus placebo capsules, representing discontinuation of methotrexate and tocilizumab monotherapy.

duration_follow_up.value: Ongoing 2-year trial; this report presents the planned first 24-week analysis, including the primary endpoint.

primary_outcome.value: Percentage of patients in DAS28–ESR remission (DAS28 <2.6) at week 24.

effect_result.value: The study did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in DAS28–ESR remission at week 24. The absolute between-group difference was 5.65% (95% CI −2.41% to 13.71%; p=0.19), smaller than the prespecified clinically relevant difference of 12.5%.

safety.value: Overall adverse-event and serious-adverse-event rates per 100 patient-years were similar between groups. Serious adverse events occurred in 17 patients (6.1%) receiving tocilizumab plus methotrexate and 16 (5.8%) receiving tocilizumab plus placebo. Liver enzyme elevations were more frequent with tocilizumab plus methotrexate; alanine aminotransferase >3× ULN occurred in 7.8% versus 1.2%, respectively, during 24 weeks.

sample_size.display: 556 randomized; 512 completed 24 weeks; planned 470 (235 per arm)

evidence_questions.objective: To assess the efficacy and safety of adding tocilizumab to methotrexate versus switching from methotrexate to tocilizumab monotherapy.
evidence_questions.population: Patients with active rheumatoid arthritis and persistent active disease despite methotrexate therapy.
evidence_questions.comparator: Tocilizumab plus placebo after discontinuing methotrexate (switch strategy/tocilizumab monotherapy).
